messages:
paula_finance: Noticed a throttling error in the NetSuite backfill run this morning. Backfill stopped after ~1.2k adjustments with status 429 on the NetSuite API. Partial state makes MTD revenue off by ~$9k. Dashboard: https://redwood.internal/billing/backfills/1780
omar_eng: Looking at the backfill worker logs: we were hitting the NetSuite REST write limit. The backfill currently does parallel batches of 50. Need to implement rate-limit aware retry with exponential backoff and an overall throttling window.
henry_billing: How many customers impacted and can we resume safely? If duplicates are created during retry we'll need to void them.
omar_eng: We have idempotency keys per adjustment but NetSuite sometimes returns 429 before recording the idempotency token. Plan: 1) reduce parallelism from 50 -> 5 for backfills 2) add a two-step create-and-confirm flow: submit, then poll for confirmation and only mark processed if confirmation returned 3) record netSuite_response_id when available so we can dedupe later.
ci-bot: job: ns-backfill v1.3 triggered by ci at 2026-10-02T09:10Z :rocket:
soph_support: Can support pause backfill and notify affected customers? We prefer to be proactive if adjustments delay more than 24h. I can prepare a template.
paula_finance: Pause it now. We need a dry-run after adding rate-limit handling. Omar, please provide an estimated ETA for the fixed backfill and a list of the invoices already adjusted so accounting can reconcile.
omar_eng: Will pause and revert to dry-run. ETA for fix ~3h. SQL for current adjusted count: `SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ns_adjustments WHERE backfill_run_id = 'run_20261002_0910';` We'll export the list as CSV for accounting.
henry_billing: Also include a flag in the CSV for "confirmation_status" so we know which adjustments are fully confirmed vs pending. For the 1.2k partials, we'll need a safe retry plan to avoid double credits.
omar_eng: Agreed. After fix we'll run a confirm-only pass for pending adjustments (no re-creates) and then a cautious re-run for failed ones with lower concurrency. I'll add metrics for 429 counts and a circuit-breaker to stop the backfill if error rate > 5% for 5 minutes.
soph_support: I'll draft customer outreach and list affected accounts for review.
paula_finance: Thanks. Once backfill is fixed and dry-run validated, we can approve resuming. Keep this thread updated and attach the CSV when ready.
